nodes.name: Manual isolated test
nodes.notes: Whole-workflow isolated entry only. Verify separate test destinations before execution.

nodes.name: Poll inactive
nodes.notes: 60-second schedule, inactive until reviewed owner manual adoption.

nodes.name: Read control
nodes.notes: Read singleton workflow interlock; this does not own the runner task slot.

nodes.name: Validate entry
nodes.notes: Validate exactly one well-typed global row. Unknown control state stops.

nodes.name: Already held
nodes.notes: Skip work if another execution holds the guard; never expire or reset it.

nodes.name: Report existing hold

parameters.jsCode: return [{json: {status:'skipped_held', control:$input.first().json}}];

nodes.notes: Report diagnostic hold without clearing it.

nodes.name: Prepare acquisition
nodes.notes: Capture execution ID and time for compare-and-set acquisition.

nodes.name: Acquire control
nodes.notes: Acquire idle guard conditionally; requires production workflow concurrency=1.

nodes.name: Check acquire receipt
nodes.notes: Verify typed acquisition response before external work.

nodes.name: Read acquired control
nodes.notes: Read persisted singleton rather than trusting write acknowledgement alone.

nodes.name: Verify acquisition
nodes.notes: Require exact guard ownership before calls or mutations.

nodes.name: Require acknowledged completion
nodes.notes: Only acknowledged submission/collection or no-work can release workflow guard.

nodes.name: Read before release
nodes.notes: Read singleton again to prevent releasing another execution.

nodes.name: Verify release ownership
nodes.notes: Check execution, time and completed issue context before clearing busy.

nodes.name: Release control
nodes.notes: Clear workflow busy only. Runner slot release requires separate stopped/publication proof.

nodes.name: Check release receipt
nodes.notes: Require busy=false with unchanged diagnostic ownership.

nodes.name: Read released control
nodes.notes: Read persistence to confirm guard release.

nodes.name: Confirm idle
nodes.notes: Fail closed if persisted idle state differs from acknowledgement.

nodes.name: Report completion

parameters.jsCode: return [{json: {status:'released', outcome:$('Require acknowledged completion').first().json.outcome, control:$input.first().json}}];

nodes.notes: Report bounded orchestration completion, never infer agent completion from guard release.

nodes.name: Discover tracked issues
nodes.notes: Read all pages, including closed owner tasks. Failed or truncated discovery retains busy.

nodes.name: Select tracked issue
nodes.notes: Rotate across sorted owner Building/QA and closed active tasks by UTC minute, so unchanged QA cannot starve another result. Approved tasks cannot be overwritten by stale PRs.

nodes.name: Have tracked issue
nodes.notes: No tracked task releases acquired busy as no-work.

nodes.name: No work
nodes.notes: No candidate: release this execution only.

nodes.name: Set issue context
nodes.notes: Record selected issue only while this execution owns busy; uncertain receipt stops.

nodes.name: Check issue context
nodes.notes: Confirm diagnostic context before remote mutations.

nodes.name: Read issue
nodes.notes: Read current issue state, owner and captured title/body; concurrent changes must stop processing.

nodes.name: Read comments
nodes.notes: Read complete source/handoff/result evidence; edited, duplicate or missing association holds.

nodes.name: Read events
nodes.notes: Read full owner approval history so a newer reapproval takes precedence over old results.

nodes.name: Read pulls
nodes.notes: Paginate all PRs; list results are discovery only and never establish merged status.

nodes.name: Read association
nodes.notes: Prepare complete discovery snapshot. Detailed current PR will verify merge before transition.

nodes.name: Read needs ledger
nodes.notes: v2 associations require authenticated ledger identity; historical v1 retains its recorded manual handoff policy.

nodes.name: Read runner attempt
nodes.notes: Read current marked attempt from the runner, never infer validity from owner-owned factory token alone.

nodes.name: Read attach ledger
nodes.notes: Attach only authenticated durable attempt/result. Unknown runner identity stops tracking.

nodes.name: Read historical snapshot
nodes.notes: Historical v1 snapshot has no runner dependency; preserve existing Basic A evidence.

nodes.name: Read ledger snapshot
nodes.notes: Join versioned snapshot paths before policy evaluation.

nodes.name: Read plan

nodes.name: Have tracking work
nodes.notes: A validated read with no marker or state change completes as no-work now. New PRs or merges arriving afterward wait for the next poll; only planned writes need rechecks.

nodes.name: No tracked changes
nodes.notes: Acknowledge this read-only snapshot and release only the acquired execution guard. Preserve Building/QA and all markers; later external changes are handled by a fresh poll.

nodes.name: Compare snapshot
nodes.notes: Repeat source/history/result reads immediately before writes; changes hold rather than guessing.

nodes.name: Need marker
nodes.notes: Existing current-attempt marker suppresses duplicate comments.

nodes.name: Post result marker
nodes.notes: Post one current approval/PR/head marker. Unknown POST outcome retains busy without retry.

nodes.name: Check marker receipt
nodes.notes: Confirm exact body, actor and created-comment receipt before labels.

nodes.name: Need transition
nodes.notes: Unchanged QA/no result skips all label writes.

nodes.name: Add result state
nodes.notes: Add QA/Done before removing source. Preserve unrelated labels; partial transitions hold.

nodes.name: Check target receipt
nodes.notes: Require acknowledged source and target labels before source removal.

nodes.name: Remove previous state
nodes.notes: Remove only prior managed state. Never closes an issue, merges a PR or adds Approved.

nodes.name: Check state receipt
nodes.notes: Unknown/partial label outcome retains busy for owner inspection.

nodes.name: Complete tracked result
nodes.notes: Require final source/result/marker/state readback before releasing busy.

parameters.content:
## 1. Acquire guard

Preserve held context; only verified acquisition permits remote work.

## 2. Associate current attempt

Captured source and owner approval must match; v2 uses authenticated ledger/exact pushed SHA, historical v1 uses handoff baseline.

## 3. Recheck and record result

Recheck before writes; post once, add target then remove source. Unknown effects hold.

## 4. Confirm and release

Read-only polls release after a validated snapshot; writes require final readback. Errors never release.
